# Security Policy

Please do not publish suspected vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, or
private information in a public issue.

Report security concerns privately to
[contact@bhalaji.com](mailto:contact@bhalaji.com) with:

- the affected page or workflow;
- steps to reproduce the problem;
- the potential impact; and
- any recommended mitigation.

This is a static portfolio and does not intentionally collect visitor data or
provide authenticated user accounts.
